feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 June 2026 11:57am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 29 June 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland will fill and moving northwards, as another low moves northeast wards towards Ireland. Associated weather fronts will affect the Irish Sea tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 occasionally 5, backing South or Southwest 4 or 5 this afternoon or evening. Then tonight backing South or Southeast 4 or 5 in many waters, but 5 or 6 later in west of area, then becoming generally South 4 or 5 later tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain and drizzle spreading from the west tonight and tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times tonight and tomorrow morning.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon. Veering Northwest overnight into Wednesday, increasing 4 or 5, then decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4 on Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle soon clearing, becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in the rain and drizzle at first.
